title: [BE] Delete `[scatter|gather]ViewTensor` wrappers
body:
Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack/tree/0.14.0) (oldest at bottom):
* __->__ #197742

Since the copy-cast migration to Metal (#184740) both functions were just `copy_cast_kernel_mps` behind an `at::empty` and a zero-numel guard that `exec_unary_kernel` already performs. Their `has_storage()` contract -- "the gather declined, fall back to `.contiguous()`" -- could no longer be triggered, so every caller carried an unreachable fallback branch. Export `copy_cast_kernel_mps` from `Copy.h` instead and let the callers copy directly.

Authored with assistance from Claude Code.
